name: claude-howto
description: A visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code — from basic concepts to advanced agents, with copy-paste templates that bring immediate value.
one_liner: A free, structured tutorial series that teaches developers how to actually use Claude Code well, with diagrams, quizzes, and copy-paste templates instead of just a feature list.
buyer: A developer or small team lead who just adopted Claude Code and wants a guided path to get real productivity out of it instead of fumbling through trial and error.
business_use_cases: A dev team onboarding new hires points them at this guide instead of writing their own internal Claude Code training material.
A coding bootcamp or corporate trainer uses the modules as the backbone of a paid 'AI-assisted development' workshop.
A freelance developer uses the advanced templates to set up client projects with production-ready hooks and subagent pipelines faster, billing for the setup.

money_ideas.idea: Turn the guided learning path into a paid cohort-based course or live workshop with office hours.
Sell a premium tier of more advanced, maintained templates and plugin bundles beyond the free repo.

steal_this: Package the existing modules into a one-day paid live workshop for teams adopting Claude Code — the content already exists, the repo just needs a presenter.
